declare
 CURSOR unitNote_cur(pc_unitID VARCHAR2) IS
 SELECT note_id
 FROM units
 WHERE chapter_id = :UTRS.CHAPTER_ID -- V09 (global.chapter_id to utrs.chapter_id)
 AND unit_id = pc_unitID; 

 l_sql VARCHAR2(2000);
 ln_noteID NUMBER; 
 ln_unitID VARCHAR2(20);
begin
 if :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id is null
 then
 show_error('0903');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 ln_noteID := :units.note_id;
 ln_unitID := :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id;
 
 l_sql := 'UPDATE units ' 
 || ' SET note_id = LN$NoteID ' 
 || ' WHERE chapter_id = ''' || :UTRS.CHAPTER_ID || '''' -- V09 (global.chapter_id to utrs.chapter_id)
 || ' AND unit_id = ''' || ln_unitID || '''';
 
 
 /* Before calling the routine check if note ID is in database. Initially note ID may not be available but when a new note is saved, 
 and user tries to reenter NOTES screen without exiting UNITQ screen, note ID will still be null. So get the not ID from the db.
 */
 
 IF ln_noteID IS NULL THEN
 OPEN unitNote_cur(ln_unitID);
 FETCH unitNote_cur INTO ln_noteID;
 CLOSE unitNote_cur;
 END IF;
 
 CALL_WINDOW_FOR_NOTES(pl_notes_for => 'UNIT_ID', 
 pl_value => 'Unit ID - ' || ln_unitID , 
 pl_sql => l_sql, 
 pl_note_id => ln_noteID);
 

 BUTTON_LBLS.set_labels;
end;

 SELECT count(*) INTO nCnt
 FROM note_books nb,

 SELECT count(*) INTO nCnt

 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO nCnt

 AND chapter_id = :CTRL_BLK_1.CHAPTER_ID
 AND TRUNC(coll_date) = TRUNC(:CTRL_BLK_1.COLL_DATE);

PROCEDURE SET_TB_NOTES_INDICATOR(p_tb_id IN VARCHAR2) IS

 cursor_rec VARCHAR2(10);
 
 FUNCTION notes_count RETURN NUMBER IS
 nCnt NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(distinct tbh.tb_id) INTO nCnt
 FROM test_batch_hdr tbh,
 note_books nb
 WHERE tbh.tb_id = p_tb_id
 AND tbh.note_id = nb.note_id
 AND tbh.note_id IS NOT NULL;
 
 RETURN nCnt; 
 END notes_count;
 

BEGIN
 IF p_tb_id IS NULL THEN
 RETURN;
 END IF;
 
 GO_BLOCK('UTRS');
 FIRST_RECORD;
 
 
 LOOP
 IF :UTRS.TB_ID = P_TB_ID THEN
 cursor_rec := :SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD;
 IF NVL(:utrs.s_tb_notes_ind, 'N') = 'Y' THEN
 IF notes_count = 0 THEN -- NOTE IS DELETED, RESET INDICATOR
 :UTRS.S_TB_NOTES_IND := 'N';
 SET_ITEM_INSTANCE_PROPERTY('UTRS.S_TB_ID_NOTES_PRESENT', CURRENT_RECORD, visual_attribute, 'VA_NORMAL');
 END IF; 
 ELSE
 IF notes_count <> 0 THEN -- Noted added. Add indicator.
 :UTRS.S_TB_NOTES_IND := 'Y';
 SET_ITEM_INSTANCE_PROPERTY('UTRS.S_TB_ID_NOTES_PRESENT', CURRENT_RECORD, visual_attribute, 'VA_RED_BG'); 
 END IF; 
 END IF;
 END IF; 
 
 EXIT WHEN :SYSTEM.LAST_RECORD = 'TRUE';
 NEXT_RECORD;
 
 END LOOP;
 
 GO_RECORD(cursor_rec);
END;
